title: Task audit: what was asked and never finished

chat.text: Of 1,303 past tasks, 254 never recorded a landing. Sorted (354 list rows, including todo, queue and asks): 83 asked and never started, 126 half-done, 35 probably done but unverified, 110 test or scratch runs. Priority ask first: the prompt-refinement pipeline has the clean transcript, coverage table and ladder view built, but context cards, interactive request cards in the chat, handoff, and filing requests at the class or page with a back-reference are missing (11 rows at the top of the list). The list is a first pass: Haiku verdicts were about 58% right on a spot check, so half-done is the least certain column. Open the list page and spend report from this card. Nothing was executed.
